notes: Capability card 'Tasmanian tin: the best drill intercepts' (exact card prompt). Not part of the gate.

questions.q: What are the best tin drill intercepts in Tasmania at a 0.5% Sn cut-off? Show them on a map.
questions.judge: Calculates tin intercepts from Mineral Resources Tasmania downhole assays at a 0.5 % Sn cut-off and states the minimum width and maximum internal dilution used. Lists the top holes as length at % Sn from depth with grade x length in percent-metres (not gram-metres), e.g. Renison Bell, Mt Bischoff, Queen Hill or Mt Lindsay holes, and shows a map. Says lengths are downhole, not true widths, and that these are calculated from government-compiled assays, not company-reported or resource figures. Mentions the Drill intercepts page for trying other settings. Credits Mineral Resources Tasmania. Must not invent values.
